findings: Actual coordinator speaker drops occur with zero playback credit despite a current ready player/authorized route. WSS sequence continuity alone does not prove PCM continuity upstream of packet assignment.
Persistent output monitoring does not eliminate the condition. A real240ms parent task can delay the existing two-hop relay/credit path and cause bounded drops with eight credits.

Same-round direct Worker/Worklet media with unchanged eight-frame queue removes the two observed stall-related coordinator drop bursts. It does not eliminate every early or later loss, and no production implementation is selected or qualified from this alone.

One bounded direct render probe is near-complete while browser output is substantially distorted; render/output windows overlap but are not sample-identity aligned, so this is a layer lead, not a complete remaining root cause.

NoSDK Oscillator and native generated-Worklet controls both remain near-complete across the tested UI stalls for default44100 and explicit48000 output specifications. Neither hidden child realm nor sample-rate conversion alone explains the failure.

NoSDK actual duplex capture/Worklet control also shows an impaired output window and later fresh recovery, including with separate mic Context. Therefore all output loss cannot be attributed solely to the SDK relay. Private virtual-device/runtime scheduling remains a separate causal investigation.

Onebrowser sameContext/sink/actualmic crossover keeps SDK channels/processors active and changes only the audible gain. Native oscillator under the same240msUIstall remainscomplete; SDKPCM under its stall has10relay drops/output0.7252; subsequent native and SDKPCM windows bothrecovercomplete without re-enable. This confirms a UIrelay contribution without assigning all startup/noSDKduplex output losses to it.
limits: Fresh profiles, actual headed Chrome158, private synthetic devices and current project fixture only. No physical devices, full24class audit, natural8h,90min1000operation stress or resource acceptance.
Runtime direct-media diagnostic wrappers and an extra processor are counterfactual instrumentation, not immutable repaired SDK qualification.
PCM2s capture windows, capped100-frame ingress records and2.5s render probes are not all sample-identity aligned; spectral/credit results retain their distinct scopes.

Several short startup and later windows fail the unchanged0.8 whole-window tone threshold. No failed study is relabeled passed, no threshold/buffer increase, and no historicalP17 acceptance is rewritten.
